content: Heyam duhkham anagatam. (The suffering which is yet to come can and should be prevented).
author: Patanjali
explanation: Yoga is a proactive science of consciousness. Through early discernment of habitual tendencies (*samskaras*), we can extinguish karmic seeds before they blossom into misery.
practicalInsight: Identify a recurring negative habit before it triggers today. Intercept the impulse early with conscious breathing and deliberate choice.
reflectionPrompt: What future sorrow can I avoid right now by choosing awareness over unconscious reaction?
